io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes

Class SerializationUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.datatypes.SerializationUtils

  • public final class SerializationUtils
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe (1.8+) serialization helpers. Everything here serializes to plain Strings so the data can be persisted through the String-keyed PersistentDataAPI without ever referencing the 1.14+ org.bukkit.persistence.* types in bytecode.
